epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.long_name: Median emergency department length of stay for {variant.short_name} encounters
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.short_description: Median time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure for {variant.short_name} encounters.
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.long_description: Median emergency department length of stay in minutes for {variant.short_name}. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the {variant.short_name} bucket of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. This is the most robust of the length-of-stay statistics in this source: unlike the mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum, it is not distorted by the small number of encounters with corrupted arrival or departure timestamps, and it is the recommended default for trend and cross-state comparison. It is published for the 'Overall' age row and for each five-year age band at the state level (see the age variable). It runs well below the mean for every mental health bucket, which is the signature of a long right tail of boarded patients. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and left missing; a missing value and a suppression flag of 1 mean the same thing, because every value the source published is carried through as published. A flag that is itself missing means the exports do not report this statistic for that row (outside the quarters it covers, or not a stratum the column describes). Note that the 'All ED encounters' variant is the total row of the ED Diagnoses grouper: it covers every ED encounter, including the non-mental-health diagnoses not displayed as their own columns, and is not a total of the mental health buckets.
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.statement: In {location}, the median {variant.short_name} ED encounter lasted {value} minutes.

epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.short_name: Suppressed flag: median ED length of stay, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} median ED length of stay
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} median ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.long_description: This flag is 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the {variant.short_name} median ED length of stay because the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters, and 0 otherwise. These statistics are not counts, so a suppressed value cannot be imputed - there is no published denominator to impute a numerator against - and epic_ed_los_median_{variant} is left missing wherever this flag is 1. Within the quarters the export covers, a flag of 1 and a missing value coincide exactly. Epic omits suppressed rows from these exports entirely, so a flag of 1 can also mean the row was not returned. The flag is missing where the exports do not report the median for the row at all (outside the quarters it covers, or all-cause on a state or age-band row). Check it before comparing across geographies: suppression is heavy in the sparser diagnosis buckets.

epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}.long_name: Percentage of emergency department encounters with a {variant.short_name} diagnosis
epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}.short_description: Percent of all ED encounters nationally in the quarter that carried a {variant.short_name} diagnosis.
epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}.long_description: Share of emergency department encounters accounted for by {variant.short_name}, as a percentage of all ED encounters nationwide in the quarter. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the {variant.short_name} bucket of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Read directly from the source's 'Percentage of Sliced Population' field on the national diagnosis row, where its denominator is all ED encounters. Published nationally (geography 00) for the 'Overall' age row only: at state level the same field is the state's share of the national diagnosis volume, not a case mix, so it is not published. Percentages carry about three significant digits at source, so small shares are rounded coarsely. The diagnosis buckets are not guaranteed to be mutually exclusive, so they should not be assumed to sum to a total. The all-cause variant is omitted: it is 100% by construction.
epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}.statement: In the United States, {value}% of ED encounters were for {variant.short_name}.

epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}_suppressed_.short_name: Suppressed flag: percent of ED encounters, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}_suppressed_.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} percent of ED encounters
epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}_suppressed_.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} percent of ED encounters was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant}_suppressed_.long_description: This flag is 1 when the national {variant.short_name} percent of ED encounters was not published, and 0 when a value was published. These statistics are not counts, so a suppressed value cannot be imputed and epic_ed_pct_visits_{variant} is left missing wherever this flag is 1. The flag is missing on rows where the column does not apply (state rows and age-band rows) and outside the quarters the export covers.

age.long_name: Age at time of ED visit
age.short_description: Age band of the patient at the time of the emergency department visit.
age.long_description: Age at the time of the visit, in bands: 0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-44, 45-64 and 65+. '0-24' is the sum of the four bands below 25 and is populated for the visit count only. 'Overall' is the unstratified row covering all ages. The bands (and 0-24) do not add up to 'Overall' in the visit counts or in the age shares. Median and quartile length-of-stay columns are populated on 'Overall' and on state age-band rows; the age share (epic_ed_pct_age_*) is populated on state age-band rows only; the diagnosis share (epic_ed_pct_visits_*) is national 'Overall' only. The all-cause visit count (epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause) is populated on every age band, on 0-24 and on 'Overall', nationally and by state.

epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.long_name: First-quartile (25th percentile) emergency department length of stay for {variant.short_name} encounters
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.short_description: Time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure that 25% of {variant.short_name} encounters fall under.
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.long_description: First quartile (25th percentile) of emergency department length of stay in minutes for {variant.short_name}: one quarter of encounters ended in less time than this. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the {variant.short_name} bucket of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. Read with epic_ed_los_median_{variant} and epic_ed_los_q3_{variant} it describes the spread of stays, and the Q3 - Q1 gap is a measure of boarding that, like the median, is not distorted by the small number of encounters with corrupted timestamps. Published for the 'Overall' age row and for each five-year age band at the state level (see the age variable); the national row is Overall age only. Suppression is heavier in small states and in the Other bucket. The all-cause variant covers every ED encounter, including the non-mental-health diagnoses, and is published nationally for all ages only. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and left missing; a flag of 1 means suppressed or not returned, and a flag that is itself missing means the export did not report this statistic for that row.
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.statement: In {location}, one quarter of {variant.short_name} ED encounters lasted under {value} minutes.

epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_name: Suppressed flag: first-quartile ED length of stay, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} first-quartile ED length of stay
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} first-quartile ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_description: This flag is 1 when Epic Cosmos did not publish the {variant.short_name} first-quartile ED length of stay because the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters, and 0 when a value was published. It is missing when the age-sliced export does not report this statistic for the row (for example outside the quarters the export coverss, or for a row that is not a stratum the column describes). These statistics are not counts, so a suppressed value cannot be imputed and epic_ed_los_q1_{variant} is left missing wherever this flag is 1. Because Epic omits suppressed rows from the age-sliced exports entirely, a flag of 1 can also mean the row was not returned.

epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.long_name: Third-quartile (75th percentile) emergency department length of stay for {variant.short_name} encounters
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.short_description: Time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure that 75% of {variant.short_name} encounters fall under.
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.long_description: Third quartile (75th percentile) of emergency department length of stay in minutes for {variant.short_name}: three quarters of encounters ended in less time than this, so the longest quarter of stays - the boarders - sit above it. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the {variant.short_name} bucket of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. Unlike the maximum it is robust to corrupted timestamps, which makes it the usable upper-tail statistic in this source. Published for the 'Overall' age row and for each five-year age band at the state level (see the age variable); the national row is Overall age only. Suppression is heavier in small states and in the Other bucket. The all-cause variant covers every ED encounter, including the non-mental-health diagnoses, and is published nationally for all ages only. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and left missing; a flag of 1 means suppressed or not returned, and a flag that is itself missing means the export did not report this statistic for that row.
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.statement: In {location}, three quarters of {variant.short_name} ED encounters lasted under {value} minutes.

epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_name: Suppressed flag: third-quartile ED length of stay, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} third-quartile ED length of stay
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} third-quartile ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_description: This flag is 1 when Epic Cosmos did not publish the {variant.short_name} third-quartile ED length of stay because the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters, and 0 when a value was published. It is missing when the age-sliced export does not report this statistic for the row (for example outside the quarters the export coverss, or for a row that is not a stratum the column describes). These statistics are not counts, so a suppressed value cannot be imputed and epic_ed_los_q3_{variant} is left missing wherever this flag is 1. Because Epic omits suppressed rows from the age-sliced exports entirely, a flag of 1 can also mean the row was not returned.

epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}.long_name: Percentage of a state's {variant.short_name} emergency department encounters that were in the age band
epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}.short_description: Percent of the state's {variant.short_name} ED encounters in the quarter that fell in the age band.
epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}.long_description: Age distribution of {variant.short_name} emergency department encounters: of all of a state's ED encounters in the quarter with a {variant.short_name} diagnosis, the percent that were in the row's age band. The source field is 'Percentage of Sliced Population' for the age slice, whose denominator is the state's {variant.short_name} encounters at every age. The seven bands (0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-44, 45-64, 65+) sum to roughly 87-90% rather than 100%, in addition to any band suppressed or not returned; the cause of the shortfall is not known. It is a share of the diagnosis, not a share of all ED encounters, so it describes who the {variant.short_name} patients are rather than how common the diagnosis is in each age group. Published for age-band rows at the state level only; it is missing on the 'Overall' age row and nationally. Percentages carry three significant digits at source, so small shares are rounded coarsely. Missing where the cell was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}.statement: In {location}, {value}% of {variant.short_name} ED encounters were in this age group.

epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}_suppressed_fla.short_name: Suppressed flag: age share of {variant.short_name} ED encounters
epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}_suppressed_fla.long_name: Suppression flag for the age share of {variant.short_name} ED encounters
epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}_suppressed_fla.short_description: Indicates whether the age share of {variant.short_name} ED encounters was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_pct_age_{variant}_suppressed_fla.long_description: This flag is 1 when Epic Cosmos did not publish the age share of {variant.short_name} ED encounters because the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters, and 0 when a value was published. It is missing on rows where the column does not apply (the 'Overall' age row, national rows) and outside the quarters the export coverss. Because Epic omits suppressed rows from the age-sliced exports entirely, a flag of 1 can also mean the row was not returned.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'

epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause.long_name: Number of emergency department visits, all encounters
epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause.short_description: Number of Epic Cosmos ED encounters, for any diagnosis, in the geography, quarter and age band.
epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause.long_description: Number of Epic Cosmos emergency department encounters with a United States country of residence, for any diagnosis, attributed to the patient's state of residence and the calendar quarter of arrival. It is the Number of ED Encounters from the Epic Cosmos state-by-age-by-month crosstab, as exported; the only step applied is summing the three months of each quarter. 'Overall' is the all-ages total Epic reports for the geography. The age bands are the age rows Epic reports; they do not add up to 'Overall' (they cover roughly 81% of a state's all-ages visits), and the cause of the difference is not known. A 'No value' age row in the export is disregarded. The 0-24 row is the sum of the four exported bands below 25 (0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24), published where all four are available; its flag is 1 if any of them was imputed. Cells of 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and imputed as 5. It covers all ED encounters, not only the mental health diagnoses, and it is available for quarters before the length-of-stay statistics begin.

epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause_suppressed_fl.long_name: Suppression flag for the ED visit count
epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause_suppressed_fl.short_description: Indicates whether the ED visit count includes a month that was suppressed and imputed as 5 at source.
epic_ed_n_visits_all_cause_suppressed_fl.long_description: This flag is 1 when at least one of the three months summed into the quarter was built on 10 or fewer encounters, so Epic Cosmos suppressed it and it was imputed as 5, and 0 otherwise. Unlike the length-of-stay flags the value is kept, not left missing, because a count can be imputed.
